definitions.explanation: A student attending high school (grades 10-12 in Japan, typically ages 15-18).

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{高校生|こうこうせい}です。
examples.english: My daughter is a high school student.

examples.japanese: {高校生|こうこうせい}の{時|とき}、サッカーをしていました。
examples.english: When I was a high school student, I played soccer.

examples.japanese: この{電車|でんしゃ}は{高校生|こうこうせい}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many high school students on this train.

examples.japanese: {高校生|こうこうせい}になったら{部活|ぶかつ}を{始|はじ}めたい。
examples.english: I want to start a club activity when I become a high school student.

examples.japanese: {高校生|こうこうせい}の{息子|むすこ}は{毎日|まいにち}{部活|ぶかつ}で{遅|おそ}く{帰|かえ}ってくるので、{夕食|ゆうしょく}はいつも8{時|じ}{過|す}ぎになる。
examples.english: My high school son comes home late every day because of club activities, so dinner is always after 8 o'clock.

notes:
{高校生|こうこうせい} is a compound of {高校|こうこう} (high school) + {生|せい} (student).

RELATED TERMS:
- {高校|こうこう}: high school (short for {高等学校|こうとうがっこう})
- {中学生|ちゅうがくせい}: middle school student
- {小学生|しょうがくせい}: elementary school student
- {大学生|だいがくせい}: university student

JAPANESE SCHOOL SYSTEM:
- {小学校|しょうがっこう}: elementary (6 years)
- {中学校|ちゅうがっこう}: middle school (3 years)
- {高校|こうこう}: high school (3 years)
